title: Post-Item6 governance milestone and pre-pilot verification registration
description: Record the canonical closure of Item 6 and the permanent end of bootstrap exceptions, register the Owner-required Pre-Pilot Verification Gate, and record mandatory Item 7 process hardening after repeated scope-slip incidents, without changing the frozen implementation numbering or starting Item 7 implementation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Governance records Item 6 as canonically closed and records that bootstrap exceptions are permanently closed after PR #166.
The frozen implementation order remains unchanged: Item 7 is Token Telemetry and Docs Automation, Item 8 is Pilot tasks LOW→MEDIUM→HIGH, Item 9 is Calibration, and Item 10 is V1 Production Gate.
An Owner-required Pre-Pilot Verification Gate is registered as a prerequisite before the first Item 8 pilot, without renumbering or amending the frozen architecture/specification.

The Pre-Pilot Verification Gate covers controller/unit regression, cross-controller integration, deterministic LOW/HIGH dry-runs without LLM execution, and negative fail-closed scenarios including lock conflict, risk downgrade, artifact mutation, unauthorized evidence, external-head PR, and spoofed check identity.
No Item 7 implementation is started and no code, workflow, product, database, or current-state files are modified by this documentation-only task.

The accidental out-of-scope marker commit created during preparation is removed from branch history before PR creation and is documented in a dedicated post-mortem incident record with corrective/preventive actions.

Repeated scope-slip incidents are escalated into mandatory Process Hardening: Item 7 cannot close until automated fail-closed scope validation prevents unauthorized mutation/commit paths and the scope-safe recovery playbook is canonical.

The artifact is rebuilt on canonical main at 90c5fe9ffa35ee5bb6d162df9ec9583d2efab4f0 after proving no overlap between intervening canonical changes and this task's four write paths; all pre-rebase artifact evidence is stale.
